valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (talaatmoustafagroupholding) is served under two keys, EGS691S1C011.CA PE 12.66 and TMGH PE 12.56, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
